A '''crowd-control shield''' was a type of shield made of curved [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]].

Crowd-control shields were used by [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] agents during [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]] when defending [[Centerpoint Station]] from [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]].
